# Compute circular topography data

Compute circular topography data

## Usage

``` r
circular_topography_data(theta, x, conditional = TRUE, ...)
```

## Arguments

- theta:

  Angles in radians.

- x:

  Real-valued response.

- conditional:

  If `TRUE`, rows are normalized to estimate `f(x | theta)`.

- ...:

  Additional arguments passed to
  [`estimate_cyl_density()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/estimate_cyl_density.md).

## Value

A data frame with columns `theta`, `x` and `density`.

## See also

Other cylindrical dependence helpers:
[`estimate_cyl_density()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/estimate_cyl_density.md),
[`phase_loom_data()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/phase_loom_data.md),
[`stat_orbit_data()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/stat_orbit_data.md)

## Examples

``` r
dat <- simulate_cylindrical(n = 80, seed = 1)
circular_topography_data(dat$theta, dat$x, n_theta = 24, n_x = 30)
```
